name: ichimoku_cloud_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: Ichimoku Kinko Hyo ('one glance equilibrium chart') provides a multi-factor trend assessment system: Tenkan-sen (conversion), Kijun-sen (base), Senkou Span A/B (cloud), and Chikou Span (lagging). On 1-min Indian intraday charts, Ichimoku with adapted parameters (9/26/52 replaced with 7/22/44 for 1-min frequency) provides: (1) trend direction via cloud color and price position relative to cloud, (2) momentum via Tenkan/Kijun cross, (3) support/resistance via cloud boundaries. The inefficiency exists because: (1) Ichimoku is designed for daily charts (Japanese trading week = 9/26/52 days); the 1-min adaptation requires parameter recalibration, (2) most Indian traders use Ichimoku with default daily parameters even on intraday, getting lagged signals, (3) the 'cloud twist' signal (Senkou A crosses Senkou B) on 1-min charts predicts trend changes 22 bars ahead, providing a forward-looking signal unique to Ichimoku.
stock_filter: ADV > ₹50 crore, sufficient intraday range (>0.5% typical daily range)
session: 09:30-15:15 IST (need 44 bars for full Ichimoku initialization)

conditions: close > senkou_span_a AND close > senkou_span_b (price above cloud — bullish)
long.confirmation: tenkan crosses above kijun (TK bullish cross event)

conditions: close < senkou_span_a AND close < senkou_span_b (price below cloud — bearish)
short.confirmation: tenkan crosses below kijun (TK bearish cross event)

entry.entry_price: market order at TK cross confirmation bar close

exit.stop_loss: price enters the cloud (close between senkou_span_a and senkou_span_b)
exit.trailing_stop: kijun_sen acts as trailing stop (exit if close crosses kijun against position)
exit.signal_exit: TK cross reverses (tenkan crosses kijun against position direction)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX between 12 and 22 (Ichimoku needs trending markets, not dead or chaotic)
filters.time_filter: wait until 09:30 (need 44 bars for full initialization at 7/22/44); stop at 14:30
filters.trend_filter: all 5 Ichimoku signals must agree (price above cloud, TK bullish, chikou bullish, green future cloud)
filters.event_filter: skip on range-bound choppy days (Ichimoku generates false crosses in ranges)
other_filters: skip if cloud thickness < 3 bps (thin cloud = weak trend, unreliable signal)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low — Ichimoku is well-known but rarely calibrated for 1-min intraday. The adapted parameters (7/22/44) for 1-min bars are non-standard and provide an edge over traders using default 9/26/52 on intraday charts.

weaknesses: Ichimoku is a lagging indicator system — all signals are confirmed after the move has started. On 1-min bars, even the adapted parameters create 5-10 bar lag, missing the initial move.
Range-bound days generate multiple false TK crosses. The 'all 5 signals agree' filter reduces false signals but also reduces trade frequency significantly.
The forward-projected cloud (22 bars ahead) uses current data to project future support/resistance, but new information in those 22 bars can completely change the cloud structure.
prior_art: Hosoda Goichi (1969) original Ichimoku development. Sasaki & Takita (2015) 'Ichimoku Charts: An Introduction to Ichimoku Kinko Clouds'. Elliott & Kildahl (2007) 'Ichimoku Charts' — English language reference. In India, Ichimoku is featured on Kite/TradingView but with daily parameters.
notes: Parameter rationale: 7/22/44 instead of 9/26/52 because 1-min bars generate ~375 bars per session vs ~250 daily bars per year. The ratio 7:22:44 ≈ 1:3:6 matches the original 9:26:52 ≈ 1:3:6 structure but for faster timeframes. Some practitioners use 9/26/52 even on 1-min; we find 7/22/44 more responsive.
